question: As per the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines, in the event of a name change by a bank (as happened with North East Small Finance Bank Limited in May 2025), existing cheque books and IFSC codes will ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**remain valid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** guidelines, when a banking entity undergoes a name change or rebranding, the transition is managed to ensure minimal disruption to customer services. 
 
• In the instance of **North East Small Finance Bank Limited** (which underwent a transition in **May 2025**), the **RBI** ensures that technical identifiers such as the **IFSC (Indian Financial System Code)** and **MICR codes** **remain valid** to facilitate uninterrupted **NEFT**, **RTGS**, and **IMPS** transactions. ***Hence, the statement regarding their validity is correct.***
 
• Existing **cheque books** issued under the former name **remain valid** and can be used by the customers until the leaves are exhausted or until a specific "sunset date" is announced by the bank. ***Hence, the statement that they remain valid is correct.***
